effect_description_eng:
When any of your Digimon with the [Ver.1] trait would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, place 1 Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon as the top security card.
